purpose: Daily temporal aggregation of dashboard/session activity.
grain: One row per daily temporal trend date.

session_count.description: Session count associated with the daily trend.

total_events.description: Event-related aggregate stored for the daily trend.

avg_session_duration_seconds.description: Average session-duration metric stored for the daily trend.

event_count.description: Event-count metric stored for the daily trend.

unique_sessions.description: Number of unique sessions associated with the daily trend.

formula_policy.note: Exact calculation formulas for session_count, total_events, avg_session_duration_seconds, and event_count were not established from the inspected evidence.
